C usually plural: B1 [ C usually plural ] an accepted principle or instruction that states the way things are or should be done, and tells you what you are allowed or are not allowed to do

U: C2 [ U ] a period of time during which a particular person or group is in control of a country

I or T: B2 [ I or T ] to control or be the person in charge of something such as a country
B2 [ I or T ] to be the most important and controlling influence on someone
› [ I or T ] to decide officially

T: › [ T ] to draw a straight line using something that has a straight edge

NONE: › the usual situation
普遍情況；慣常的事，通常發生的事

example: A referee must know all the rules of the game.
裁判一定要通曉比賽的所有規則。
The first/most important rule in life is always to appear confident.
人生的首要法則就是永遠要表現得自信。
Before you start your own business you should be familiar with the government's rules and regulations.
在創立自己的公司之前，你應該了解政府的有關條例和規定。
You must follow/obey/observe the rules.
你一定要遵守規則。
You must not break the rules.
你千萬不可違反規則。
In special cases the manager will bend/stretch the rules (= allow the rules to be broken slightly).
在特殊情況下，經理會對這些規定進行變通。
You can trust Ruth because she always plays (it) by/goes by/does things by the rules (= follows instructions, standards, or rules).
你可以信任露絲，她做事一貫遵守規矩。
[ + to infinitive ] It's against the rules (of/in boxing) to hit below the belt.
擊打腰帶以下的部位是違反（拳擊比賽）規則的。
[ + that ] It's a club rule that new members must sing a song.
新成員一定要唱一首歌，這是俱樂部的規定。
The period of Fascist rule is one people try to forget.
那段法西斯統治的歷史時期是人們想要努力忘卻的。
We don't want one-party rule - we want rule by the people.
我們不想要一黨專政－－我們想要的是民治。
See also
misrule
Most modern kings and queens rule (their countries) only in a formal way, without real power.
現代的大多數國王或女王（對他們的國家）的統治都只是形式上的，並不握有實權。
She rules her household with an iron hand/fist (= severely).
她在家裡攥著大權，持家很嚴。
Love ruled supreme in her heart.
她的心已被愛所俘虜。
The desperate desire to go to Moscow ruled their lives.
要去莫斯科的強烈願望支配了他們的生活。

Only the Appeal Court can rule on this point.
只有上訴法院才可以就這一問題作出判決。
The judge ruled for/in favour of/against the defendant.
法官作出了有利於／不利於被告的判決。
[ + that ] The government has ruled that the refugees must be deported.
政府已經作出決定，難民必須被驅逐出境。
[ + obj + noun/adj ] The courts have ruled his brave action illegal.
法院裁決他的勇敢行為不合法。

She ruled two red lines under the title.
她在標題下面畫了兩條紅線。
In England, it often seems that rain is the rule all year long.
在英格蘭，人們常感覺好像一年到頭總在下雨。

NONE: C1 a practical and approximate way of doing or measuring something
實用的估測方法；經驗之談；經驗法則

example: A good rule of thumb is that a portion of rice is two handfuls.
有個方便實用的估算方法，即兩把生米便是夠一人吃的量。

NONE: › is the best
是最棒的；必勝；無敵

example: The graffiti on the wall said "Liverpool rules OK".
滿牆都是「利物浦隊必勝」的塗鴉文字。

NONE: C2 to decide or say officially that something is impossible or will not happen, or that something or someone is not suitable
把…排除在外；拒絕考慮

example: The police haven't yet ruled out murder.
警察尚未排除謀殺的可能性。
I won't rule out a June election.
我不排除六月份進行選舉的可能性。
The police have not ruled him out as a suspect.
警察尚未排除他的嫌疑。

NONE: › to prevent something from happening
使…成為不可能，使…不可能發生；防止

example: This recent wave of terrorism has ruled out any chance of peace talks.
最近的這一波恐怖行動已經使得任何和談的機會都化為泡影。

NONE: › to control a group of people very firmly, having complete power over everything they do
以鐵腕手段控制
› to be the person who makes all the decisions in a group
當家作主；主宰；支配一切

example: In that family it is the grandma who rules the roost.
那個家庭是奶奶當家。

NONE: › a book containing the official rules for an organization or activity
規則手冊，規章手冊

C: C1 the leader of a country

A2 old-fashioned or formal rule a long, narrow, flat piece of plastic, metal, or wood with straight edges where centimetres or inches, or both are printed. It is used for measuring things and for drawing straight lines.

example: The country was without a ruler after the queen died.
女王死後，這個國家陷入了無人統治的狀態。

NONE: › used to say that it is good and acceptable to not obey a rule
（用於表示違反一項規則合情合理）制定規則是為了被打破的。
› orders that soldiers fighting in a war are given about what they can and cannot do
交戰規則

example: The soldier fired on a wounded man, an apparent breach of the rules of engagement.
這名戰士向一個傷患開槍，明顯違反了交戰規則。

NONE: C2 a decision
裁決；裁定；判定；決定
› being in control and making all the decisions
統治的，支配的；佔統治地位的

example: [ + that ] The court has made a final ruling on the case that the companies acted illegally.
法庭對此案作出終審判決，判涉案公司違法經營。
The Communists are the ruling party at the moment.
當前共產黨是執政黨。
